result.title: Where Small Mistakes Matter: Quantifying State Criticality for Imitation Learning
result.comment: Accepted to the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). 18 pages, 10 figures, 8 tables. Project website: https://sia-lab-git.github.io/SCRIM/
result.summary: Imitation learning typically treats every demonstration state as equally important, optimizing a behavior-cloning objective uniformly across the dataset. Yet not all states are created equal: in a small number of critical states, even a slight deviation from the expert action can lead to a failure, while in many other states such errors are recoverable and inconsequential. We formalize state criticality in imitation learning as the worst-case degradation in downstream value induced by a bounded perturbation of the expert action at a given state. We then propose SCRIM, a practical State CRIticality Measure that estimates this quantity by training an adversarial disturbance policy and a value critic around a fixed imitation policy. SCRIM assigns each demonstration state a score reflecting how vulnerable the task outcome is to small, policy-relevant action errors. We show that these scores can be used to reweight behavior-cloning losses, improving imitation at consequential states and increasing overall task performance. We further show that SCRIM enables data curation by selecting compact, high-value subsets of demonstrations that preserve performance while substantially reducing the amount of training data. We evaluate SCRIM across various simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks, and demonstrate that SCRIM improves policy training, enables efficient data selection, and provides interpretable insights into which moments in a demonstration are most critical for task success. Project website: https://sia-lab-git.github.io/SCRIM/

AI.brief_summary: 论文将模仿学习中的「状态关键性」形式化为专家动作受有界扰动时下游价值的最坏退化，并提出 SCRIM：围绕固定模仿策略训练对抗扰动策略与价值评论家，为每个演示状态打分，用于重加权行为克隆损失与筛选高价值演示子集，并在仿真与真实机器人操作任务上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「关键性＝有界扰动下价值最坏退化」的度量与对抗扰动加价值评论家的估计方式，可能为 LVR 判断哪些 latent 推理状态或步骤对最终答案真正关键、以及据此重加权或筛选训练轨迹提供问题表述与评价线索，但是否可迁移到 latent 状态与推理步尚待核查。
